The Tivoli eventually closed in 1966.

The first radio broadcast from the building was made on 15 March 1932, and the building was officially opened two months later, on 15 May.  The main building is in Art Deco style, with a facing of Portland stone over a steel frame.  It is a Grade II* listed building and includes the BBC Radio Theatre, where music and speech programmes are recorded in front of a studio audience, and lobby that was used as a location for filming the 1998 BBC television series "In the Red".
